author: claude
text:
spec: provider adapter contract — externalize provider layer

Amends ARCH §4 with the provider adapter contract (discovery,
describe/complete subcommands, error protocol, SIGTERM cancellation,
env-var auth, schema versioning). Extends §3.1 and §3.2 to list the
adapter as an external subprocess invoked per model call. Generalizes
the externalization principle in PRINCIPLES.md so tools (§3.3) and
provider adapters (§4.4) both point at the same pattern. Adds
"provider adapter" as a lernie-specific term of art in TAXONOMY.md §2,
distinct from the overloaded "provider". README gains a short
Providers note pointing at §4.4.

Spec only; no code changes. Extracting the v0.1 in-process Anthropic
client to the adapter contract is deferred as follow-up.
